ar: في وقت متأخر من الليل مع الشيطان
ov: في وقت متأخر من الليل مع الشيطان هو فيلم رعب أسترالي إماراتي مُشترك أنتج عام 2023، وهو من تأليف وإخراج الأخوين الأستراليين كاميرون كيرنز وكولين كيرنز، ومن بطولة ديفيد داستمالشيان ولورا جوردون. عُرض الفيلم لأول مرة عالميًا في 10 مارس (آذار) 2023 في مهرجان الجنوب الغربي السينمائي.
plotEn:
The film's prologue is framed as a documentary investigating an unexplained event that occurred on the night of Halloween 1977, during the live broadcast of a sixth-season episode of the struggling variety late-night talk show Night Owls with Jack Delroy, which competes for ratings with The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson.
Night Owls host Jack Delroy, based in New York City, regularly visits "The Grove," an elite California camp for wealthy and powerful men. After his wife Madeleine dies of cancer, production of Night Owls is suspended. Jack eventually returns and, seeking to revive the show's ratings, hosts an occult-themed Halloween episode featuring self-proclaimed psychic and medium Christou, skeptic and former magician Carmichael Haig, parapsychologist Dr. June Ross-Mitchell, and June's latest subject, 13-year-old Lilly, who is purportedly possessed by a demonic spirit. Carmichael offers a large check to anyone who can prove that supernatural phenomena exist.
During the broadcast, Christou suffers a severe headache and has a premonition involving someone named "Minnie." Carmichael dismisses the episode as a performance until Jack reveals that "Minnie" was his private nickname for Madeleine. Christou becomes violently ill, vomits a black liquid, and is taken to the hospital.
